opening_message:
Ticket 1: Casey Wu (employee ID E005) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 6 note(s) about employee E005.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Casey Wu (E005) is a full-time Payroll Specialist requesting write access to Source Code. As a full-time employee, max is write (admin only for role owning the system; Source Code is owned by Engineer). Grant write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by IT agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Casey Wu (E005) is a full-time Payroll Specialist requesting write access to Source Code. Full-time employees max is write; admin only for role owning the system (Source Code is owned by Engineer, not Payroll Specialist). Requested write is at the maximum, so grant write.
Note 3 (ticket 1), written by Finance agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Finance DB confirms Casey Wu (E005) is a Payroll Specialist. As a full-time employee, max access is write; admin only if role owns the system (Source Code is owned by Engineer, not Payroll Specialist). Requested write is at the maximum, so grant write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Compliance DB confirms Casey Wu (E005) is a Payroll Specialist, full-time. Source Code is owned by Engineer, so full-time max is write (admin only for the owning role). Requested write is at the maximum, so grant write.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms Casey Wu (E005) is a Payroll Specialist; team notes show full-time. Source Code is owned by Engineer, not Payroll Specialist, so full-time max is write (admin only for owning role). Requested write is at the maximum, so grant write.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent, note 5 by Facilities agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB check: Casey Wu (E005) is a CONTRACTOR with BASIC security training, not full-time as other notes state. Contractors max is read (write only with advanced training; never admin). Source Code is owned by Engineer, not Payroll Specialist. Requested write exceeds contractor max, so grant read.
reason: Conflict in the notes: most notes (copied from HR) state Casey Wu is full-time, but the Security agent verified in its own database that Casey Wu is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractor employees can have read, or write only with advanced security training, and never admin. Casey has basic training, so the maximum allowed is read. The requested write exceeds that maximum, so the maximum is granted: read.
